title: astragalus kentrophyta subsp. danaus
intro: Astragalus kentrophyta subsp. danaus, commonly known as the "Island Milk Vetch", is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to support immune function and alleviate respiratory issues, attributed to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus kentrophyta subsp. danaus are believed to be attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
